name: W2U Apparel
old_description: Branding Businesses, Organizations and Individuals Through Apparel and Promotional Products.
about:
W2U Apparel operates from Salem, Oregon, where it has occupied a dedicated shop since 2018. The business was founded in 2010, beginning at a kitchen table before moving to a print table as demand grew. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the company describes its origins as a necessity-driven venture that expanded from a home workspace.

The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, and graphic design services, producing decorated apparel and promotional items for clients. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include businesses seeking branded merchandise, schools such as Sprague High School, sports teams ordering custom jerseys and caps, and individuals commemorating events like senior nights. The firm also produces sublimated business cards and other promotional gear.

W2U Apparel emphasizes fast turnarounds, responsive service, and a hands-on approach that it describes as bordering on obsessive. The shop’s personality is reflected in its resident dog Remmy and cat Tito, which the company highlights as part of its culture.
type_evidence: We specialize in custom screen printing, embroidery, and graphic design — crafting high-quality apparel that reps your brand, team, or personal style like a pro.
